prior_knowledge: Published repository baselines and literature were known; previous five-fold B0/teacher results already include fold 1. Fold 1 is untouched for NEW block screening, not claimed as a pristine external confirmation. No new modality-screen result file was read to select this set.
confirmation_rule: One final fused-model evaluation after selection: band M1 CI lower >0.50 and positive M8 point gain over nuisance N. Five-fold post-selection event results explicitly labelled post-selection.
audio_gate: Phase B blocked until independent diegetic-audio audit is frozen; candidates are not approved audio cases.
label_policy: Frozen v2 labels remain primary. Model-selected visual/UCA masks are proposals only; any approved masks are a versioned, separately labelled sensitivity analysis, never a silent replacement.

P0.directions: Cue probabilities higher=risk except calm, intervention, separation, retreat, apology, deescalation lower=risk. Generic embedding dimensions have no P0 arm. Freeze any additional direction/schema before its outcomes are read.

P1.selection: validation source+time matched band AUROC; ties choose smallest C
P1.target: pre-violence 30<tte<=120 vs clean with remaining>=60; train-only time_match_weights by source-kind x TIME_MATCH_EDGES
P1.history: causal; normalize by available history; reset at cuts
P1.reduction: train-only weighted band-target PLS32; full-dimensional L2 sensitivity

P1b.rule: Subtract per-video mean over observed ticks <=10 only after tick10; mask earlier baseline-dependent outputs; no future baseline fill.

P2.loss: band BCE plus event-window MIL loss; coefficient1, frozen before P2 outcomes

nuisance.features: source-kind x TIME_MATCH_EDGES indicators plus tick2 SigLIP2 scene with pose person boxes greyed out

metrics.M3p: UCF first-band vs H1p time-to-anomaly band, time matched; H1 never in training
metrics.M8: event window max vs source+time matched clean windows, same observed window length up to90sec

G1.PASS: point>=0.58 and adjusted one-sided CI lower>0.50
G1.sparse_PASS: standardized pAUC>=0.55 and CI lower>0.50 OR tail-hit difference CI lower>0
G1.multiplicity: Holm across blocks within phase; one-sided paired cluster-bootstrap p-values; alpha0.05

G3.PASS: paired M1 gain vs N >=0.02 and CI lower>0

classes.ANTICIPATION: G1 PASS, G3 PASS, G2 not FAIL
classes.PROVISIONAL: G1 PASS, G2 and G3 not FAIL, not ANTICIPATION
classes.CONTEXT_SHORTCUT: G1 PASS and G2 FAIL or G3 FAIL
classes.SHORT_HORIZON: G1 not PASS, near CI lower>0.60

tags.RAMP: within-video paired difference mean(0-30)-mean(60-120), majority rising, Wilcoxon p<0.05

forward_selection: Best ANTICIPATION block, greedily add ANTICIPATION/PROVISIONAL while paired M8 gain lower>0; evaluate final set on fold1 once.

exceptions.context_cues: Weapon/police/counter/arrivals exempt G2 only as class-conditional/auxiliary heads
exceptions.soundtrack_flag: movie M1 exceeds diegetic S_audio M1 by >0.08

no_survivor: No 30-second claim; report Success@10/@20 and sustained results descriptively.
amendments: Append a dated hashed amendment before reading affected block outcomes; never overwrite this v1 file.
